newsitem.title: USA: PSA recommends 1500 EDT US bond mkt close July 3.
newsitem.headline: PSA recommends 1500 EDT US bond mkt close July 3.

text.p: In observance of U.S. Independence Day, PSA The Bond Market Trade Association recommended an early close of 1500 EDT/1900 GMT on July 3 for U.S. bond markets.

PSA extended its recommendation for an early close from its usual 1400 EDT time due to the 1400 release of the minutues from the Federal Open Market Committee May 20 meeting. The early close will not affect the closing time for settlements, PSA said.
PSA previously recommended a full market close on July 4.
The recommendations are for U.S. government, corporate, mortgage and municipal bond markets and trading in commerial paper and Yankee and Euro Certificates of Deposit.
